finalProse.chartStory: The main event is that CAT tried to bounce from the 20-day average, but that first bounce failed quickly.
finalProse.whyItMatters: A failed first bounce usually means the pullback is not ready to resume higher yet, so traders should treat support as unproven.
finalProse.setupLocation: Price is sitting between the 20-day and 50-day averages after a failed support defence.
finalProse.learningPoint: A touch of the 20-day average matters less than the quality of the first buyer response that follows it.
finalProse.whatNext: Watch for a stronger reclaim of the 20-day average with better follow-through before trusting the pullback again.
